uncertainty.episode: Average seed differences/values within each common episode, then estimate SE or percentile-bootstrap complete episodes. Conditions on fitted policies.
uncertainty.training_seed: Sample SD and Student t4 95% CI across five independent training-seed means, conditional on this fixed evaluation cohort.
uncertainty.fixed_reference: Reuse the identical fixed-5 episode outcomes for each training seed, and average seed differences before episode resampling.
uncertainty.budget: Pair long and short checkpoints by training seed and exact fresh episode ID; original pilot evaluation results are not read.
uncertainty.limitations: Separate conditional intervals are not a joint interval. Five-seed t intervals are approximate. No timestep or seed-by-episode pseudoreplication.
